SELECT feedback.id, feedback.member_id AS memberId, member.nickname, member.account, member.mobile, member.avatar, feedback.content, feedback.contact, feedback.status, feedback.reply_content AS replyContent, feedback.reply_time AS replyTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_member_feedback_image image WHERE image.feedback_id = feedback.id AND image.deleted = 0) AS imageCount, feedback.create_time AS createTime, feedback.update_time AS updateTime FROM s_member_feedback feedback LEFT JOIN s_member member ON member.id = feedback.member_id AND member.deleted = 0 WHERE feedback.deleted = 0
AND feedback.status = #{status}
AND ( feedback.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR feedback.contact LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(feedback.member_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_member_feedback_image image WHERE image.feedback_id = feedback.id AND image.deleted = 0)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_member_feedback_image image WHERE image.feedback_id = feedback.id AND image.deleted = 0)
AND feedback.create_time >= CONCAT(#{createStart}, ' 00:00:00')
AND feedback.create_time <= CONCAT(#{createEnd}, ' 23:59:59')
AND feedback.status = '1' AND feedback.create_time <= #{overdueBefore}
ORDER BY feedback.create_time DESC, feedback.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN feedback.status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN feedback.status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN feedback.status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS resolved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_member_feedback overdue WHERE overdue.deleted = 0 AND overdue.status = '1' AND overdue.create_time <= #{overdueBefore}) AS pendingOverdue FROM s_member_feedback feedback LEFT JOIN s_member member ON member.id = feedback.member_id AND member.deleted = 0 WHERE feedback.deleted = 0
AND ( feedback.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR feedback.contact LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR member.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(feedback.member_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_member_feedback_image image WHERE image.feedback_id = feedback.id AND image.deleted = 0)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_member_feedback_image image WHERE image.feedback_id = feedback.id AND image.deleted = 0)
AND feedback.create_time >= CONCAT(#{createStart}, ' 00:00:00')
AND feedback.create_time <= CONCAT(#{createEnd}, ' 23:59:59')
